chunks: There is no wudu (ablution) in kissing, intimate contact, nor touching the private part.
ai.seo_question: Do kissing, intimate contact, or touching the private parts invalidate wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that kissing, intimate bodily contact, and touching the private part do not in themselves invalidate wudu (ablution). It is cited in the context of rulings on what nullifies ritual purity.
